_doc: check_prerequisites contract E-A9 produces (D6, PRD.md:52-54; AC-19..AC-23, AC-27). Check names are the response `checks[].name`. Wording is the builder's; the content tokens and exclusivity are the contract. Existing names/fields kept: success, checks[], summary, per-check passed/detail/remediation/warning/skipped.

failures.name: docker
failures.trigger: docker info rejects with error.code === 'ENOENT' (dockerUtil.js:86 copies err.code)

failures.name: docker
failures.trigger: docker info fails, error.stderr does not match /permission denied/i, code not ENOENT

failures.name: docker_compose
failures.trigger: docker compose version fails (runs even when the daemon is down; skipped only when docker is missing)
failures.must_name: the fix command (apt: sudo apt-get install docker-compose-plugin, from Docker's repo)

failures.name: docker_group
failures.trigger: docker info fails with permission denied
failures.if_user_in_docker_line_of_/etc/group: must contain 'log out and back in'

failures.name: disk
failures.trigger: free bytes under 10 GB on DockerRootDir (docker info --format '{{.DockerRootDir}}') or on the filesystem of the install dir (nearest existing ancestor of /opt/xns-relayer)
failures.must_state: free space and which filesystem (Docker root / install dir)
failures.threshold: 10 GB = 10 * 10^9 bytes (AC-23 DECISION; fails at 10*10^9 - 1, passes at 10*10^9, on each filesystem separately). Docker-root leg skipped when the daemon is remote (DOCKER_HOST) or `docker info` was refused (permission denied); install-dir leg still runs

pairwise_distinct: the five failure messages (detail) differ from each other and from the retired shared text 'Docker is not available or not running'

port_checks_with_own_container.when: findContainer('xns-relayer').running and `docker port xns-relayer` publishes 8888/tcp and 9000/tcp on host ports 8888 and 9000 (only when docker info was permitted; on permission denied the port checks are skipped, see permission_denied)
port_checks_with_own_container.no_text: Stop the service using this port
port_checks_with_own_container.otherwise: unchanged: bind-probe failure -> passed:false with today's remediation

existing_install_check: still passed:true, warning:true (checkPrerequisites.js:139-154); the remediation text changes: it must not tell the visitor to stop or remove a running install the script made (AC-27 CR-1)
permission_denied: docker check passed:true with a detail that the socket refuses this user; only docker_group fails (AC-22); Docker-root disk leg reports skipped; the 8888 and 9000 port checks report skipped with the group note (never failed, findContainer is not consulted: dockerUtil.js:146-148 returns null when denied); compose check still runs (docker compose version needs no socket)
